function_codes.note: Use 0x03 (Read Holding) for ALL registers. 0x04 (Read Input) is served ONLY for read-only registers; issued against a read/write register it returns a malformed response (MBAP Length = 0, no PDU). IMPORTANT: the control registers 11300-11303, 11320-11324, 11330 and 11442-11444 MUST be written with 0x06 single-register writes, NOT 0x10 block writes.

scale_note: engineering value = register_value × scale; signed types are two's-complement; RW bounds are raw register values
source: Wattsonic MATIC EMS Modbus TCP/IP Interface Specification v2.0.20

agent_layer.description: Register map of the website (Wattsonic_MATIC_Modbus_Registers.json, unchanged keys) with integration fields per register. A field is present only where the published documentation states it; absent means not specified.

fields.applies_from_firmware: ARM firmware from which the register applies as documented.
fields.write_function: Function codes accepted for writing; single_write_required = write with 0x06, one register per request.
fields.effective_when: Conditions under which a written value is used.
fields.confirm_by: Registers to read back to confirm the write is in force.
fields.persistence: retained = survives a restart; volatile = lost at restart; volatile_over_tcp = RAM-held when written over Modbus TCP port 502, stored when written over RS485; command = action register, not stored.

registers.name: Comms_Watchdog_Resume_Mode
registers.values: 0 LATCH: after a timeout the 11702 action stays in force, also across a restart, even when heartbeats resume, until it is cleared as described below. 1 AUTO-RESUME (default): the first heartbeat received in SAFE_STATE returns the watchdog to NORMAL. 2 MANUAL_CONFIRM: with the heartbeat running every 1–5 s, write 12001 = 1; the next heartbeat returns the watchdog to NORMAL. Write 11704 only while the watchdog is disabled ( 11700 = 0, or 14044 = 0) and no LATCH is stored, that is before 11700 = 1; otherwise the write is answered with exception 0x03. Recovery needs 14044 = 1 ( 11060 = 1 and 12002 = 1). 0 LATCH: set 11700 = 0, wait ≥ 2 s, write the heartbeat 12026 and within 5 s Malfunction_Clear (12001) = 1, wait ≥ 2 s, then set 11700 = 1. The latch is stored in non-volatile memory and survives a power cycle; writing 12001 while 11700 = 1 does not clear it. If 11702 = 0 (stop), also write 12000 = 1 to restart the inverter.
effective_when: Write it while the watchdog is disabled (14031 = 0) and not latched: while the watchdog runs (14031 = 1, 2 or 3, except the start-up SAFE_STATE with 14042 = 6) or is latched, a write to 11704 is answered with exception 0x03.

persistence.note: Stored in non-volatile memory: the value survives a restart.

registers.name: PowerOn_Switch
registers.values: 0: Power Off 1: Power On

write_function.note: Control command: send it with function code 0x06.

persistence.note: Command register: the value is not retained after execution.

registers.name: Malfunction_Clear
registers.values: 0: No action 1: Clear faults

write_function.note: Control command: send it with function code 0x06.

effective_when: Clears faults, clears an emergency stop (12021) and confirms watchdog recovery in modes MANUAL_CONFIRM and LATCH (see 11704).

persistence.note: Command register: the value is not retained after execution.

registers.name: Remote_Mode
registers.values: 0: Local 1: Remote Set to 1 for EMS control

write_function.note: Control command: send it with function code 0x06.

effective_when: Together with 11060 = 1 it opens EMS control; 14044 reads the combined state.

persistence.note: Reads 0 after every restart: write 12002 = 1 again after reconnecting.

registers.name: Emergency_Stop
registers.values: 1: Stop all power conversion immediately. Writing 12021 = 1 latches the inverter in the safe state. Safety-critical. Latches until cleared via 12001 Malfunction_Clear =1; then write 12000 = 1 to restart. No unlock is required.

write_function.note: Control command: send it with function code 0x06.

effective_when: No unlock is required. Latches until 12001 = 1.

persistence.note: Command register: the value is not retained after execution.

registers.name: Comms_Heartbeat
registers.values: Heartbeat: write any value except 0x5A5A every 1–5 s. Each write restarts the watchdog time (14041 = 0). 0x5A5A trips the watchdog on purpose (14042 = 2).

write_function.note: Control command: send it with function code 0x06.

effective_when: Any value resets the watchdog age (14041) except 0x5A5A, which trips the watchdog on purpose (14042 = 2).

confirm_by.expect: 0 right after the write (seconds since last heartbeat)

persistence.note: Command register: the value is not retained after execution.

registers.name: Device_SN
registers.values: 16 registers (32 bytes)

registers.name: Device_Info
registers.values: MATIC units report 10-14: 10 = 10 kW, 11 = 12 kW, 12 = 15 kW, 13 = 20 kW, 14 = 25 kW (see Model Code Reference; the rated power is also in 13034). Any other value means the device is not a MATIC inverter covered by this document.

registers.name: WIFI_App_Ver

registers.name: Inverter_Total_Working_Time
registers.values: 2 registers

registers.values: 0: General 1: Grid Balancing 2: Economic 3: UPS 4: TOU 5: Forecast 6: Off-Grid

registers.name: TOU_Submode
registers.values: 0: Self-Use 1: Charge 2: Discharge 3: Peak Shaving 4: Battery Off

registers.name: PCS_Working_Status
registers.values: 0: Self-checking 1: Standby 2: Pre-charging 3: Grid-synchronizing 4: Waiting 5: Initializing 6: Starting 7: Connecting 8: Running EMS commands are accepted only in states 1 (Standby) and 8 (Running).

registers.values: 0: Off 1: On

registers.name: DC_Power_On_Off_Status
registers.values: 0: Off 1: On

registers.name: Comms_Watchdog_Status
registers.values: 0: Disabled ( 11700 = 0 or 14044 = 0) | 1: Normal (heartbeat OK) | 2: Pre-warning: the heartbeat is overdue ( 11701 − 14041 ≤ 11703 ); write 12026 at once | 3: SAFE_STATE: the 11702 action is applied; recover as set in 11704 (cause in 14042 )

registers.name: Comms_Watchdog_Age_Sec
registers.values: Seconds since the last heartbeat write to 12026 (0 after each heartbeat, maximum 65535). Time left before the timeout = 11701 − 14041 ; the pre-warning ( 14031 = 2) starts when this is 11703 or less.

registers.name: Comms_Watchdog_Trip_Reason
registers.description: Reason for the last watchdog trip (held until the watchdog is enabled again)
registers.values: 0: Never-tripped | 1: Heartbeat timeout (age > 11701 Timeout) | 2: Manual trigger (write 12026=0x5A5A) | 3: reserved | 4: EMS control closed while the watchdog is enabled (11060 != 1 or 12002 != 1) | 5: SAFE_STATE held/restored from the EEPROM latch (not 'reserved'). | 6: restart while the EMS was in control : the unit started in SAFE_STATE and waits for the EMS's first write. Important: read this register promptly. when 11704 Resume_Mode = LATCH, the true trip reason (1-4) is readable for about 1 second after the trip; the value then changes to 5. Poll 14031 and read 14042 as soon as 14031 changes to 3. While the latch is set, the inverter also sets 11704 to LATCH ; a different Resume_Mode written while the latch is set is replaced by LATCH. To clear the latch (with 14044 = 1): 11700 = 0 → wait ≥ 2 s → heartbeat 12026 and within 5 s 12001 = 1 → wait ≥ 2 s → 11700 = 1.

registers.name: EMS_Channel_Canary
registers.description: Constant 0x1018 on EMS channels: use it to verify that you are reading the EMS register view
registers.values: Reads 0x1018 (4120) only on EMS-native channels (Modbus TCP 502, Wi-Fi 502, RS-485 RTU). This document describes the EMS-channel view; cloud channels see a different view for some addresses (e.g. 10009, 10685–10689). If this register does not read 0x1018, you are not connected to an EMS channel and the register definitions in this document do not apply.

registers.name: EMS_Control_Active
registers.values: 0: EMS disabled (local control) 1: EMS active (remote control) Combined state of EMS_Switch_Set (11060) and Remote_Mode (12002).

supplementary_registers.name: TOU_Day_Of_Week_Mask
supplementary_registers.description: Weekdays of the Eco schedule: bit0 = Monday to bit6 = Sunday, 0x7F = every day.

write_function.note: Write with function code 0x06 (one register per request). An 0x10 block that covers this address does not reach this setting.

persistence.note: Stored in non-volatile memory: the value survives a restart.

supplementary_registers.name: SunSpec_Control_Gate
supplementary_registers.description: SunSpec control gate. Write 0x5355 (21333) to open it; any other value closes it. Factory default 0. Stored in non-volatile memory. Closing the gate releases every held SunSpec control within 1 s.
